title: Before Sleep
subtitle: A short surrender of the night
intro: At the end of the day, make the Sign of the Cross, forgive all, and lay the night down into God's hands.
source: Common Orthodox prayer book (PD English; the prayers before sleep, carried in nearly identical form in the Jordanville and St. Tikhon's traditions).

prayers.title: Forgiveness
prayers.instruction: Before resting, forgive all who have wronged you:
prayers.text: O Lord our God, in what I have sinned this day in word, deed, or thought, do Thou, as good and the Lover of mankind, forgive me. Grant me peaceful sleep, free from disturbance; send Thy guardian angel to shelter and keep me from all evil; for Thou art the guardian of our souls and bodies, and to Thee we send up glory: to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

prayers.title: Into Thy hands
prayers.text: Into Thy hands, O Lord Jesus Christ my God, I commend my spirit; do Thou bless me, do Thou have mercy on me, and grant me life eternal. Amen.

prayers.title: The Jesus Prayer
prayers.text: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner. (3x)
